query:
DROP TABLE restaurant_reservations;

CREATE TABLE restaurant_reservations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  reference VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  type ENUM('particulier', 'entreprise', 'groupe') NOT NULL,
  slotId INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  displayChoice ENUM('brasserie', 'jardin') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jardin',
  seatsTotal INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(320),
  companyName VARCHAR(255),
  groupName VARCHAR(255),
  groupType VARCHAR(50),
  status ENUM('pending_validation', 'validated_pending_payment', 'paid_confirmed', 'refused', 'cancelled', 'completed', 'no_show') DEFAULT 'pending_validation' NOT NULL,
  paymentStatus ENUM('not_requested', 'pending_payment', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded') DEFAULT 'not_requested' NOT NULL,
  paymentAmount DECIMAL(10, 2),
  paymentProvider VARCHAR(50),
  paymentReference VARCHAR(100),
  qrToken VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE,
  qrStatus ENUM('inactive', 'active', 'used', 'expired') DEFAULT 'inactive',
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  processedBy INT,
  processedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_reference (reference),
  INDEX idx_type (type),
  INDEX idx_status (status),
  INDEX idx_email (email),
  INDEX idx_createdAt (createdAt)
);
